name: Natsume Sakuya
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c13945]Akira[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c13950]Kurumi's[/url] childhood friend. She took care of them both after their father died while their mother went to work to support them. Because of this, they both often call her Nee-san. She is strict toward Akira, so Kurumi will often tattle on him to her. Her alternate reality self is good friends with [url=http://vndb.org/c13947]Miruku[/url] and is also a magical girl.

She has strong magical powers, but doesn't know how to control them well. This often leads to unintended side effects to her magic.
